column1: # The red run: this tree's assertions against the engine the base ref holds,
# written whole by tests/red, which tests/run --record-assertions calls.
#   base  <ref>  <sha>  <engine version there>
#   run   <failed>  <passed>  <skipped>        lines counted, not the summary
#   <assertion name>  <times it failed>        failed names only
#   an assertion the manifest lists that the base run never reached counts as failed, by its shortfall
# A base of - means no complete red run was made: none was possible, the
# suite stopped before reached or reached no assertion, or tests/red itself
# was stopped; its stdout said which unless it was the one stopped.
# Reproduce with: tests/red <ref>
base
run
a bridged receipt from another environment refuses with run another environment
a bridged receipt that ended more than twelve hours ago refuses with run older than 12 hours
a bridged receipt whose origin/main has moved since refuses with run origin/main moved
a commit holding one of the two changes, the other still uncommitted, stands on the bridge with Y's sha
a line the gate's search pattern finds
a receipt that recorded no origin/main stands across the commit, with the seventh field
a run on the very commit origin/main named, then committed, refuses with C10.5's reason
after exactly those changes are committed as Y, the receipt stands, the seventh field naming Y's full sha
and its first line says the run was then committed as Y's first 8
and its last line is the summary, unchanged
and no part of the suite ran
and so does one on a commit the recorded origin/main has below it
tests/run --reuse on the bridged receipt exits 0
